## Change

Link the issue. Describe the problem, resulting behavior, and prerequisite PRs.

## Validation

List checks/results, relevant acceptance criteria, and remaining evidence gaps.

## Before merge

- [ ] Prerequisites are merged and the diff contains the intended change.
- [ ] Applicable checks and CI pass on the current revision.
- [ ] Independent review findings are resolved; link the review evidence.
- [ ] Handed to the integration owner with the correct target/merge method.

Feature/fix/docs/chore: squash into `devel`. Release: merge commit into `main`,
with approved version and evidence. Mark the implementation issue Done after
merge; track release completion separately.
